title: Unit converter page
prompt:
Build a unit converter web page with index.html, style.css, convert.js and page.js (plain JavaScript, no libraries, no build step).
convert.js must also work in Node: end it with `if (typeof module !== "undefined") module.exports = { convert, units, format };`.
- Units: length mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi (1 in = 2.54 cm, 1 ft = 12 in, 1 yd = 3 ft, 1 mi = 1760 yd); mass g, kg, oz, lb (1 lb = 453.59237 g, 1 lb = 16 oz); temperature C, F, K.
- units(kind) -> the list of units for "length", "mass" or "temperature", in the order above; an unknown kind throws an Error.
- convert(value, from, to) -> the converted number. An unknown unit, or units of different kinds, throws an Error whose message contains "cannot convert". A temperature below absolute zero throws an Error.
- format(n) -> a string with at most 4 decimals and no trailing zeros (format(2.50000) is "2.5", format(1/3) is "0.3333", format(5) is "5", format(-0.00001) is "0").
page.js connects the page: a kind picker, a number input, from and to pickers, and the result shown as you type. Write a Node test file for convert.js too (node test_convert.js).
